title: feat(types,components)!: retire filter-builder nesting at the name authority; components derives FilterBuilderCondition / FilterGroup (objectui#9306)
body:
Fixes #9306
Clause-②: yes

Implements the maintainer's ruling on this card (comment `5857342228`, letter A, 「A 撤掉嵌套声明(推荐)」): retire filter-builder nesting at the name authority, and make `@object-ui/components` derive its row and group from `@object-ui/types`, in one PR. Ruling `5852274286`'s other terms stand (components' `FilterBuilderOperator` = the protocol set plus the opt-in `exists` / `notExists`, exported by name, unfolded). objectui#6349's two parked name-authority rows are settled here; the note on objectui#6349 stays with the landing seat.

Implemented by a dispatched `os-dev` run in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk` (seat `domain:ui#1`), branch `claude/issue-9306-filter-builder-name-authority`.

## What changes

**`@object-ui/types` (the authority)**
- `FilterGroup.conditions` is now flat `FilterBuilderCondition[]` (it was the condition-or-group union).
- `FilterGroupSchema` judges every entry as a row, and an entry that carries its own `conditions` is refused BY NAME: exactly ONE `custom` issue at the entry's own path (`value.conditions.N` on a node), whose message says the sub-group is retired and what to write instead. The same string is the published `.describe()` of `conditions`.
- `FilterBuilderSchema.allowGroups` / `maxDepth`: `?: never` tombstones with `@deprecated` on the TS face, `retirementTombstone()` on the mirror (an `invalid_type` issue at the key). Tombstones, not deletions, because the node is `.passthrough()` and an undeclared key is KEPT in silence (pin block d measures that).
- `FilterGroupSchema` no longer names itself, so its `z.lazy` is memoised like `FilterBuilderConditionSchema`'s; the objectui#7918 ledger moves it from `TDZ_BOUND` to `MEMOISED`. Its public type (`z.ZodType` of `any`) is unchanged.
- Docblocks: the isValidGroup cross-file line addresses (already stale) and the other cross-file line addresses in the two touched files are replaced by symbols and quoted code (AGENTS.md #11, repair-when-touching).

**`@object-ui/components`**
- The hand-written `FilterBuilderCondition` / `FilterGroup` are deleted. `FilterBuilderCondition` is now an interface extending the authority's row with `operator` and `value` omitted, and restating exactly those two as named extensions: `operator: FilterBuilderOperator` (was `string`), and `value` keeps the component's own required scalar-or-list union (execution parameter (i) from the box `5857198401`). `FilterGroup` extends the authority's group with `conditions` omitted and restated as the component's rows, so `id` is OPTIONAL, as the authority declares it (premise 2 held: `onChange` hands back an id-less group id-less; only the builder's own empty group carries `id: 'root'`).
- The narrowed `operator` needed three call sites inside the component to narrow a `string`: the operator Select handler, the read-boundary fold, and the field-switch reconcile. One internal guard, `isFilterBuilderOperator`, reads membership from the list the dropdown renders. None of the three changes what runs: every answer those paths give for a spelling the builder or the spec knows is already a builder id.

**Dependants the narrowing broke** (found by type-check, not by guess)
- `@object-ui/plugin-view` `toFilterGroup`: builds rows from an untyped stored draft with `operator: string`. The stored spelling is asserted as `FilterBuilderOperator` at that one boundary, with a comment saying why. Output unchanged: a spelling nothing maps is still carried through verbatim, on purpose, so the row stays visible.
- `@object-ui/plugin-list` `convertFilterGroupToAST.test.ts`: two fixtures that deliberately feed deprecated stored spellings (`isEmpty`, `isNull`) take the `unknown` hop the file already uses for its other off-type fixtures.

**Docs** `content/docs/components/complex/filter-builder.mdx`: the intro no longer promises nested conditions, the `FilterGroup` block is flat with an optional `id`, the `allowGroups` / `maxDepth` rows are gone, and a short "Retired" section says why and what to write instead (the objectui#10611 precedent). The `interface FilterGroup` block keeps `logic: 'and' | 'or';` verbatim, which the objectui#6939 doc reader uses as its control.

**Pins**
- New `packages/types/src/__tests__/filter-builder-nested-group-retired-9306.test.ts`: (a) sub-group refused by name, envelope `{ code, path }` and ONE issue, at `safeValidateSchema`, on `FilterBuilderSchema` through `value` and `defaultValue`, and on `FilterGroupSchema`; message == published metadata. (b) `allowGroups` / `maxDepth` refused, ONE `invalid_type` at the key, message == describe, still declared. (c) lit control: flat groups parse at both doors; a row is still judged by the row schema. (d) control: an undeclared node key is kept. (e) TS twin: `Equal` pins plus `@ts-expect-error`, judged by `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`.
- New `packages/components/src/__tests__/filter-builder-name-authority-9306.test.tsx`: type-level pins that everything but the two named extensions IS the authority's row, `id` required, `operator` equals the protocol set plus the pair and contains the authority's operator, `value` required and narrow, group `id` optional, sub-group a compile error; plus a render pin that an id-less group comes back from `onChange` id-less (control: an `id` is kept; no value emits `root`).
- `filter-builder-condition-id-8415.test.ts`: the source-text pin on the hand-written interface is FLIPPED, not deleted: it now pins that the component imports the authority's row and extends it with only `operator` / `value` omitted, and that no hand-written interface is back. Its nested-group fixture arm (which would now stay red for a reason that is not `id`) is removed with a pointer to the new pin.
- `zod-lazy-getter-identity-7918.test.ts`: `FilterGroupSchema` moves to `MEMOISED`; the test that parsed a nested sub-group now parses flat rows and refuses a bad operator.
- `filter-condition-value-protocol-rule-10478.test.ts`: the test that pinned a row nested in a sub-group now pins that the sub-group itself is refused by name, and that the rule reaches the same rows written flat.
- `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`: the `FilterGroupSchema` exclusion reason is restated (no longer recursive; still excluded transitively).

**Changesets**
- `.changeset/9306-filter-builder-nested-groups-retired.md`: `minor` for `@object-ui/types`, breaking semantics and migration stated.
- `.changeset/9306-filter-builder-name-authority.md`: `minor` for `@object-ui/components`, `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-view`.
- Three pending changesets whose in-release claims this change makes false each gain ONE appended "Superseded in this release by objectui#9306" paragraph, frontmatter and history untouched (the objectui#10534 / objectui#10465 precedent): `7918-zod-lazy-getter-identity` (FilterGroupSchema kept its spelling), `6349-name-authority-batch-3` (the two names deliberately NOT converged), `8415-filter-builder-condition-id` (the union chain an id-less row is reported through is one union shorter now; measured below). `check-changeset-overwrite` reports these, report-only case 2.

## Premises re-measured at base `6cf599985` (merge of `origin/main` into the empty claim branch, fast-forward)

- Zone 2 item 1 holds, by symbol: `FilterBuilder` destructures `fields, value, onChange, className, showClearAll, extraOperators`; it renders `filterGroup.conditions.map(...)` one flat row per entry; `addCondition` appends a flat row. `git grep -n "allowGroups|maxDepth"` over `packages/*/src`, `apps`, `examples`, `skills`, `docs`, `content` finds them only in `complex.ts`, `complex.zod.ts` and the docs page; lit control: the same grep hits `maxDepth` in `plugin-markdown/src/toc.ts` and `components/src/__tests__/test-utils.tsx`. objectstack `origin/main`: `allowGroups` in 0 files (control: `filter-builder` in 5+). Catalog census over all 494 tracked JSON files: 5 `filter-builder` nodes, 5 flat groups, 0 nested, 0 `allowGroups` / `maxDepth`.
- Zone 2 item 2: this repo's retirement pattern is the objectui#10611 shape (tombstone on both faces, envelope-asserted pin, docs "Retired" section, `minor` changeset). Followed. The sub-group refusal is not a key tombstone (an entry is a row, so `z.never` cannot sit there): it is a named `custom` arm, the objectui#6124 `handlerKeyRefusal` code, with one string feeding message and metadata.
- Zone 2 item 3 holds and is handled (flipped, see Pins).
- Zone 2 item 4: stored tenant metadata carrying nested groups is **NOT MEASURED** (nobody in this container can read tenant data). ⛔ Not claimed empty.

## Risk and cost

- **Stored nested groups (NOT MEASURED).** Any stored filter-builder value with a sub-group renders as a blank row today; after this change it is refused on its next validation or save, with a message naming the retirement. Nothing that renders correctly today stops rendering.
- **TypeScript consumers outside this repo** that build a components `FilterGroup` / `FilterBuilderCondition` with an operator typed `string`, or read a group's `id` as a guaranteed `string`, get compile errors. Declared in the components changeset with the remedy.
- **Rollback:** revert this PR. No data migration, no runtime behaviour to unwind in the renderer.

## Verification

Final heads: code `71124f208`; the components suite and the consumer type-checks ran on trees whose non-test source equals HEAD's (later commits touched only tests, docs, changesets and comments), each run through `os-verify-lock`.

Lint narrowing, stated as a measurement: the population is the 11 touched TS files as eslint itself reported them (none ignored), the count is read from the JSON output, and eslint here is not type-aware (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService` in `eslint.config.js`, no custom rule reads the disk), so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

Consumer sweep direction: downstream of `@object-ui/components` (the `...@object-ui/components` direction is 31 packages); type-checked here are the packages whose files name `FilterGroup` / `FilterBuilderCondition` / `FilterBuilderOperator` / `FilterBuilder` (fields, plugin-list, plugin-view, app-shell), found by grep across `packages`, `apps`, `examples`. Downstream of `@object-ui/types`, only components (and app-shell / plugin-list, above) name the changed symbols. The rest of the sweep is CI's.

**Ablations and the reverse check** (each leg through objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode: anchor must hit once, the mutation proven by blob change, the restore proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`; the pin re-run green afterwards, 18/18, tree clean):
- A1, mirror: `conditions` put back to the condition-or-group union. Pin: **6 failed / 12 passed**. The five sub-group refusals went red, and so did the second half of lit-control (c): with the union back, a bad operator is reported as a union issue at the entry, not at `conditions.0.operator`, so that assertion also pins that no union wraps a row any more. Blocks (b), (d) stayed green.
- A2, mirror: `allowGroups` back to a boolean. Pin: **3 failed / 15 passed** (the two `allowGroups` refusals and its one-string check); `maxDepth` stayed green.
- A3, cross-package reverse check: a nested sub-group literal typed as the AUTHORITY's `FilterGroup` pasted into the components test, whose project resolves `@object-ui/types` through the rebuilt `dist` `.d.ts` (`paths` is empty there). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`: **TS2353** at the pasted line ("'logic' does not exist in type 'FilterBuilderCondition'"), exit 1; restored, the same command exit 0. ⚠️ The first A3 attempt measured nothing: its replacement re-contained the anchor and the tool refused it (anchor 1 → 1). It was re-run with a different anchor; only the second reading is cited.

The 8415 changeset note's new union chain was measured through the built `@object-ui/types/zod` entry: an id-less row in a group is the single `invalid_union` at `["value"]`, whose arm 1 now carries `invalid_type` at `["conditions", 0, "id"]` directly.

**NOT MEASURED locally, declared:**
- `check-doc-snippet-types` / `check-doc-example-types`: need a build of roughly every package. The population is disjoint from this diff: no ts/tsx doc snippet names the changed symbols, and the edited page's only fence is `plaintext`. CI runs both.
- `check-sdui-registration-pins`: exit 2, prerequisite not met (console build absent). No registration changed.
- `pnpm check` (the CLI catalog check): needs the CLI build; the objectui#6939 pin validates all five catalog entries through `safeValidateSchema` and is green.
- `apps/console` type-check: its one use is `toFilterGroup(...).conditions[0]` `id` / `field`, whose types did not move.

## Acceptance notes (out of scope here; not filed by this PR)

- `FilterBuilderSchema.value` / `defaultValue` on the mirror are the union of a bare CONDITION and a group, while the TS face says `value?: FilterGroup` and the component's `isValidGroup` gate needs `conditions` + `logic`. Measured: `safeValidateSchema` answers success on a node whose `value` is a bare condition. The render half (the builder falls back to its empty group) is a source reading, NOT MEASURED. Handed to the seat in the report as a finding.
- `defaultValue` is declared on both faces; the `filter-builder` renderer passes `schema.value || props.value` and `FilterBuilder` has no `defaultValue` prop. Source reading only, not measured.
- The docs page's Schema block still spells the row `FilterCondition` with `operator: string`; the TS name is `FilterBuilderCondition` with the protocol's operator ids. Polish, left alone.
- `@object-ui/fields` `FilterConditionField` and `@object-ui/app-shell` `datasetFilterCondition` keep local flat `BuilderGroup` copies with `operator` typed `string` (they compile against what the builder hands back). App-shell `viewFilterFold` still refuses a nested group at runtime, now a shape the types refuse; kept as a stored-data defence.
